title: 2003 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 7
statement: Find the real value of \(x\) such that \(x^{3}+3 x^{2}+3 x+7=0\).

solutions.text:
\(\quad-1-\sqrt[3]{6}\)
Rewrite the equation as \((x+1)^{3}+6=0\) to get \((x+1)^{3}=-6 \Rightarrow x+1=\sqrt[3]{-6} \Rightarrow x=\) \(-1-\sqrt[3]{6}\).
